notes: FastTrack stuck-peg fix: pegs that landed on an ft-* hole via a regular move (instead of the explicit enterFastTrack choice) had peg.onFasttrack=false, so on subsequent cards getTrackSequence skipped the FT-ring branch and returned an empty sequence — the peg silently had no legal forward moves while teammates continued on the main track. Two-part fix: (1) the move handler now auto-sets peg.onFasttrack=true whenever a peg lands on any ft-* hole (and the card was not noFastTrack), so geometry and the flag stay in sync; (2) getTrackSequence's forward-FT branch no longer gates on peg.onFasttrack — any peg whose holeId is an ft-* hole moving forward is offered the FT ring (geometry is authoritative).
